The Chinese characters for Olivia

As a transliteration, Olivia is usually written 奥利维亚 (Ào lì wéi yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Origin and meaning

From Latin, Olivia carries the meaning “olive tree”.

About the name Olivia

Invented by Shakespeare for Twelfth Night, now a top name worldwide.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Olivia as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “olive tree”, is part of the appeal.
